headline: Calendar trimmed to Europe, Boardmasters added, Mint XL Leeds sold out

items.text: Still nothing near Munich or Oestrich-Winkel. The closest gig is Time Warp Mannheim on 3 Apr (Josh Baker, Ben Sterling), with tickets on sale.
Max Dean and Chris Stussy at Boardmasters, Newquay (UK), 4 to 8 Aug 2027. Early-bird tickets are on sale; the official line-up isn't out yet.
Gaskin at Mint XL Leeds on 18 Dec (Sidney Charles) is sold out. Doors at 22:00.

Tickets are confirmed on sale for Chris Stussy (Blackstone, 22 Nov), Sidney Charles (DOCUMENT Bristol 26 Dec, Idra 28 Dec), Alisha at Depot Mayfield (27 Dec, doors 14:00), Kolter at OVO Arena (1 Jan) and Sziget. Kolter in Angers on 12 Dec: doors 21:30.
Removed 65 gigs outside Europe (US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Australia, Dubai, Egypt, Thailand, Japan).
Out today: L.P. Rhythm "How Ya Feelin’" (Traumer Remix) on Lost Property.
Out today: "Active Scenes Vol Two" on Chaos, with Ben Sterling.
Also out today: Idemi "Feel The Power" and Kolter's remix of Empire Of The Sun "Way To Go". PAWSA "WORLDWIDE" is out on 27 Nov.
